seo.title: Placement Training Programs: 2-Month and 6-Month | CodingMonk
seo.description: A 2-month placement sprint for final-year students and a 6-month program for pre-final year students: aptitude, DSA, projects and mock interviews.

sections.heading: Placement programs for *final* and pre-final year.
sections.description: Two core programs: a 2-month sprint for final-year students and a 6-month program that starts in pre-final year. Add a mock interview drive or an AI project workshop when you need it.

sections.heading: How AI is used in *training*
sections.description: Students use AI tools the way development teams do today, and prove they can still code without them.

sections.heading: Not sure which program *fits?*
sections.description: We'll suggest one after a free skill check of one batch.
